cross_verification.note_en: Ukraine visas for foreign nationals are issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA), not by DMSU (which handles citizens' passports/ID and was reachable — see ua-passport.json). Every mfa.gov.ua property attempted in this session — mfa.gov.ua, visa.mfa.gov.ua, usa.mfa.gov.ua, uk.mfa.gov.ua, japan.mfa.gov.ua, and the visa application PDF at mfa.gov.ua/storage/... — returned HTTP 403 to both the WebFetch tool and direct curl requests with multiple realistic user-agents/headers, indicating a bot-blocking WAF rather than a missing page. Because none of this content could be actually read, no field is marked verified even though third-party aggregator sites (not cited here per the truth gate) consistently claim 30x40mm / 450x600px / light-grey background for the e-Visa system. DMSU's biometric-photo rules (used for ua-passport) are deliberately NOT cross-applied here since DMSU is a different issuing authority than MFA and the rules are not confirmed to be shared.
